items.title: Make groups from the sidebar
items.text: Right-click a window in the all-windows list and choose Create Group… to name a group right there. Move to Group and Remove from Group move windows between groups without retyping their titles.

items.title: Renames keep the group
items.text: Renaming a grouped window edits just its own name, so you can't ungroup it by accident. Type a group: prefix to move it to another group on purpose.

items.title: An Ungrouped section
items.text: Once you have a group, windows without one gather under an Ungrouped header at the top. Use its + for a new window, × to close them, or Rename to turn them all into a group.

items.title: Steadier group drags
items.text: A window dragged past the end of a group stays in that group; it only leaves when you drag it up among the ungrouped windows. The group you're dropping into glows softly, and only in the window you're dragging in.
